title: Compression Bench: A Digitally Controlled Compression Rig for Granular Media
description: Compression Bench is an open-source software package for controlling a digitally actuated compression rig used for the mechanical characterization of granular media. The software provides experiment configuration, real-time monitoring of force and displacement, automated data acquisition, visualization, and communication with an Arduino-based control system.
